Betdice is a gambling application built on blockchain smart contracts. Betdice runs on a public blockchain without a central intermediary.

Furucombo is a DeFi aggregator that lets users combine multiple DeFi actions in a single transaction. Furucombo is deployed on the Ethereum blockchain.

BurgerSwap is a decentralized exchange built on smart contracts. BurgerSwap operates on the BNB Smart Chain. BurgerSwap uses its native BURGER token.
